preflight_gate.auth_hash: Record in restricted preflight receipt only; not frozen here.
preflight_gate.tool_discovery: JSON-RPC initialize plus tools/list must advertise bateia_recommend; tools/call is prohibited in preflight.
preflight_gate.resolved_commands: Both exact argv arrays and external redirects saved before dispatch.

pair_contract.treatment_bateia_calls: exactly one completed bateia_recommend before first observable web event

profile_conformance.common_flags: All flags and twelve --disable pairs from the frozen profile must appear in each resolved argv exactly as ordered.
profile_conformance.control: No mcp_servers config argument may appear.
profile_conformance.treatment: Exactly the six frozen --config mcp_servers.bateia key/value pairs must appear; no other server or enabled tool is allowed.
profile_conformance.paths: Prompt, output-last-message, stdout JSONL, stderr and invocation paths must equal the absolute per-arm profile paths.

forbidden: tool trace, call count or cost
dimensions: decision-relevant findings with resolvable public support
novel supported alternatives, mechanisms or hypotheses

post_reveal_rubric.start: Only after blind receipt SHA-256 is frozen.
post_reveal_rubric.catalysis: Bateia direction -> later web event -> useful supported confirmation, rejection or narrowing reflected in output.
post_reveal_rubric.inconclusive: Neutral abstention; no automatic success or defeat.
post_reveal_rubric.treatment_uplift: Blind preference for revealed treatment plus at least one proven catalytic path.
post_reveal_rubric.live_web_drift: Unknown confounding unless resolved; never automatic equality.

classification.Unknown: Required identity, ordering, profile state, trace linkage, temporal comparability, parseability or support is not observable.
classification.unknown_default: No implicit success, failure, tie, zero, winner or retry.
